title: Blueberry Oat Energy Balls
excerpt: A practical, delicious snack, ideal to recharge your day. These energy balls combine the texture of oats with the juicy burst of our fresh Guasca blueberries.
imageAlt: Three oat and whole-blueberry energy balls on a rustic wooden board, with fresh blueberries scattered around.

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup unsweetened almond or peanut butter

steps: In a large bowl, mix the rolled oats, the chia seeds and the pinch of salt.
Add the almond butter, honey and vanilla extract. Stir very well with a spatula until you get a pasty, even dough.
Gently add the Fresh Pick blueberries. Do it carefully so you don’t break them, letting them spread evenly through the mixture.
Scoop portions of the mixture with a spoon and, using your hands, shape them into walnut-sized balls. If the dough feels too loose, barely dampen your hands.
Place the balls on a plate or tray lined with baking or wax paper.
Refrigerate the tray for 30 minutes so the balls firm up before you enjoy them.
tips: For this recipe, the firmness of our high-mountain blueberries grown in Guasca is perfect, since they stand up to hand shaping without falling apart and bring a burst of flavor in every bite.
Store the energy balls in an airtight container in the fridge; they will stay fresh and delicious for up to 5 days.
If the mixture feels too dry to form the balls, add a teaspoon of water or a little more honey; if it is too wet, add an extra tablespoon of ground oats.
